title: 有馬記念の後に・冥冥之志

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That was every bit the challenge I expected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But victory is mine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That said, since the Triple Crown slipped through my fingers, I will need another mark of rule to replace it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Indeed. A grand and storied race upon which to make my mark: the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: 3,200 meters is a grueling distance, but it presents the perfect opportunity to demonstrate my prowess as a stayer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And victory in the Tenno Sho grants a particular prestige.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let us honor the suffering and perseverance of our forebears with a stunning victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now more than ever, I must deliver a performance worthy of the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so we set our sights on the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We return to the waiting room to find…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You raced well today, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Air Groove. Have you been waiting for me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Only to pass on my congratulations. Now that that's done, I ought to head back home.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Is it my imagination, or do you look a little under the weather?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Your complexion strikes me as somewhat pale. As though you've been missing sleep… or perhaps meals.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Apologies. My student council duties have been taking up a lot of my time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's not like you to let them get out of hand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This year's New Year's party has required more paperwork than usual, and attending to it has been somewhat time-consuming.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From what I can gather, it sounds like Air Groove has been in charge of organizing the New Year's party that the student council runs.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Why didn't you say something? Let me take charge of this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Forgive me, President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There's no need to apologize. For all the virtue of hard work, you have been pushing yourself too much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You may be exceptional, but even you have your limits, especially in this busy season. Surely you can lean on me once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, I ought to attend to student council business.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fortuitously enough, my last great task of the year has just concluded. Excellent timing, if I do say so myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have a request for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Take care of Air Groove. See that she gets some rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And could you pick out something for us to eat while I finish things up here?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No, there's no need for that. I can do it myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Between your fatigue-addled mind and my trainer's ample experience, which would you say is the more suitable candidate?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Point taken.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then my request stands. Trainer, if you would.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a light snack, Symboli Rudolf and Air Groove head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The New Year's party ends up a great success, and is very much appreciated by the Umamusume staying at school over the holidays.
